propositions: Resolver shim module _engine_support.resolver is a whole-file re-export of rebar._ids and must be deleted after migrating 50 direct importers across src/rebar, tests/, and scripts/ to import from rebar._ids instead

Reducer processors shim at _processors.py re-exports 7 names (process_status, process_signature, process_key_event, _rederive_keyring_keys, _fold_claimed_session, _fold_close_metadata, _fold_plan_review_phase) from _processors_identity and _processors_status for backward compatibility and must be removed per ADR 0111
All 66 resolver importer lines across 50 files must be rewritten to use canonical rebar._ids module, including plain imports, module-object aliases, attribute references, and monkeypatch strings

The 7 processor re-export lines at _processors.py:18-31 must be deleted and importers redirected to _processors_identity or _processors_status; _replay.py must split its import to pull process_key_event and process_signature from _processors_identity and process_status from _processors_status

Test file test_processors_status_split.py must be deleted after moving test_status_fold_replay_equivalence and its helper to test_plan_review_phase_reducer.py; the four split-guard tests (shim assertion, package surface, import direction, target size) are one-time migration artifacts to delete

Post-migration validation requires resolver grep to return nothing, ModuleNotFoundError on import attempt, F401 cleanup in _processors.py, all edge-case imports and monkeypatch retargeting to pass pytest, and make verify to exit 0
